description: Data used in the figures of "Aseismic deformation during the 2014 Mw 5.2 Karonga earthquake, Malawi from InSAR and earthquake source mechanisms" is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Data used in Figures 2, 4, and SI3 of the paper "Aseismic deformation during the 2014 Mw 5.2 Karonga earthquake, Malawi from InSAR and earthquake source mechanisms.". Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2020; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
